Current rules cross-reference

The approved decisions are incorporated in source and teaching text. This list is navigation, not a competing set of provisional rulings.

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.1cea11a23d58e328.JournalEntryPage.83082c8f9728466c]{Damage and weakness}: highest matching resistance and weakness, normal caps, event minimum. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0ed84bf5cc8bb982.JournalEntryPage.401d23f4b66980ee]{Wounds}: if only minimum damage remains, the player chooses among original damage types. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.5ebfaad0d5ed6813.JournalEntryPage.3292b6a49dcf7236]{Stability}: collision timing and legal moving-group placement. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.56367e2f9016dd21.JournalEntryPage.9ff12960a5e160cc]{Summoning}: energy forms, no received healing, controller-paid healing and nearest-square tether. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.5c2f295c2a8d199b.JournalEntryPage.f5003d6e49eeed0c]{Session resolution}: NPC-only rolls, interruption, perception and movement. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.b65e9644d24629f2.JournalEntryPage.0237eee3512bbfa9]{Languages}: starting choices, explicit grants and communication. - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.3a45aacf3898e8b3.JournalEntryPage.9303127ab1b28c3b]{Recovery}: Grit, Dying, Last Words and lasting wounds.

New design questions belong in a new issue and require Bruce’s review. Encounter calibration remains playtest work; see further work.
